unknowns: Target analyte(s) or spectral features for the classification study.
Number and identity of tissue classes (e.g., muscle vs fat vs liver) and reference method.
Sample preparation, thickness, hydration, temperature, and storage.
Optical behavior of chicken muscle, fat, and liver in MIR and fluorescence (scattering, absorption, heterogeneity).
MIR ATR measurement parameters: crystal material, contact pressure, number of reflections, background, purge, spectral range, resolution, co-adds.
Fluorescence measurement parameters: excitation/emission wavelengths, filters, probes, fluorophores, acquisition time.
Whether MIR ATR and fluorescence measurements are sequential or simultaneous and how same-location sampling is ensured.
Performance metrics, sample size, validation, and acceptance criteria for the classification study.
Details of the spectral measurement interface (probe/optics, distance, materials, compatibility with MIR and fluorescence).
